title: The 4 v 4 vehicular combat game I've been working on
author: 1of1Games
selftext:
Howdy, game was built mostly with Claude. It's really designed with multiplayer in mind, but there are also offline bot matches and the Hard difficulty bots are no slouch. You're also able to play online against bots with a buddy as well if you'd like.

I've really been impressed more than anything with Claude's ability to provide solid online play/netcode in my experience. I've had lobbies with a handful of buddies all over the country and we didn't notice any lag at all. If anyone tries it and experiences lag, I'd love to get that feedback. TBH I've yet to have a completely full 8 person lobby so I'd be curious to see if that introduces noticeable lag at all.

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Looks pretty fun. How destructible is the environment? It looks like you clipped a corner and a piece came off.

replies.author: 1of1Games
replies.body: Thank you! All the buildings can come down completely. Vehicles also lose panels and can crumple, windows crack, etc. There is another map with some destructible buildings, derailed train cars that can be destroyed, cargo containers that get dented when you run into them and eventually get destroyed, and a derailed tanker car that explode when it takes enough damage.
